description.zh-CN: 无固定锁仓期限，不发行 Token，按笔记录本金和收益。
description.en: Individual deposits with no fixed lock-up and no token.

summary.zh-CN: 固定收益条款不消除策略、链下托管及团队履约风险。
summary.en: Fixed-return terms do not remove strategy, off-chain custody or team performance risks.

description.zh-CN: 可随时整笔申请赎回，最迟 336 小时到账；不是即时流动性。
description.en: Full-deposit redemption may be requested anytime, with payment within 336 hours; liquidity is not instant.

description.zh-CN: 期货套利仍有市场、保证金、执行和交易对手风险，不能视为无风险。
description.en: Futures arbitrage still carries market, margin, execution and counterparty risks; it is not risk-free.

description.zh-CN: 可投资本金可能离开合约，兑换法币并由团队执行策略；存在链下托管和回拨风险。
description.en: Investable principal may leave the contract and convert to fiat for team-run strategies, creating off-chain custody and returning-liquidity risks.

description.zh-CN: Tyche 承担约定本金和净收益的补足责任，仍依赖其实际资金及履约能力。
description.en: Tyche must cover the specified principal and net-return shortfalls, but repayment still depends on actual funding and ability to perform.

description.zh-CN: 当前为测试链产品；存在合约、钱包和网络风险，不把测试通过视为安全审计。
description.en: This is a testnet product with contract, wallet and network risks; passing tests is not a security audit.

description.zh-CN: 3 个月锁仓，按期次发行份额；当前月付参考净年化 6%。
description.en: 3-month series shares; current monthly-mode reference net APR 6%.

summary.zh-CN: 固定收益条款不消除策略、链下托管及团队履约风险。
summary.en: Fixed-return terms do not remove strategy, off-chain custody or team performance risks.

description.zh-CN: 到期前不能向 Vault 兑付本金；退出需要转让给买方，成交与价格不保证。
description.en: Principal cannot be redeemed from the Vault before maturity; early exit requires a buyer, with no guaranteed execution or price.

description.en: NAV-based shares with gains and drawdowns; not open.

summary.en: NAV-based holders bear drawdowns; specific strategies and liquidity terms remain undisclosed.

description.en: Lock-up, redemption windows and queues are not finalized; exit liquidity cannot yet be assessed.

description.zh-CN: 策略、资产范围与估值来源待披露，不能用目标收益代替风险评估。
description.en: Strategies, asset scope and valuation sources remain to be disclosed; a target return cannot replace risk assessment.

description.zh-CN: 资产托管、估值和运营安排须在开放前披露，目前待定。

description.en: Gains and losses change NAV; holders bear principal drawdowns, without the fixed-income shortfall obligation.
